question: Which mechanism best explains threshold triggers on the two frozen below-reference windows: rotation compensation, local-flow estimation, or the observable support manager?
non_goals: testing more than one algorithm revision
confirmation, Android, product, or safety authority

data_partitions.identity_basis: Frozen RGB input manifest plus the immutable 967-pair A4 ledger and source-native TUM geometry audit.

constraints.description: The old result, ledger, algorithm source, threshold, and frozen window identities are read-only and hash-bound.
Attribution covers exactly 967 old pairs and the support-manager counterfactual covers exactly 598 pairs from TUM windows 2 and 7.
Replay each below-reference pair with identical rotation compensation, Sparse LK, and local affine fitting while resetting PairState and forcing the baseline-only path.
The old 0.01 per-second threshold is unchanged.
constraints.rationale: Separates mechanism attribution from threshold tuning.
constraints.calibration_source: Existing frozen Phase A protocol and A4 development canary.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No neighboring threshold is evaluated in this round.
constraints.revision_policy: Any threshold change requires a separate version and is forbidden for the single revision selected from this attribution.

successor_policy.pass_successor: Freeze exactly one targeted algorithm revision on the same four development windows.
successor_policy.invalid_successor: Repair only the attribution evidence version; do not infer an algorithm cause.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Disable only support-manager carry and supplementation on the two below-reference windows, then partition old false triggers using baseline raw and compensated threshold transitions.
experiment_design.resource_budget: Two cached 10-second TUM windows, 598 pairs, two host processes, no network and no new data.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop after one complete counterfactual and one independently recomputed attribution ledger; do not test algorithm revisions in this round.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Reuse immutable A4 and source-native geometry ledgers; decode only the two below-reference RGB windows.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Most below-reference triggers already exceed threshold in uncompensated RGB flow, window 7 triggers without any support-manager activation, and false runs are short.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Separates baseline per-pair local-flow threshold crossings from crossings introduced by compensation or support recovery.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Identifies whether a temporal local-flow confirmation is the uniquely targeted next revision.
hypotheses.minimal_test: One baseline-only replay of the two frozen below-reference windows.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Disjoint count of geometry-below old triggers by attribution category.
hypotheses.falsifier: Support-manager-induced or rotation-compensation-induced categories account for a majority of geometry-below old triggers.
hypotheses.resource_budget: 598 cached pairs with two CPU workers.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Stop attribution after the fixed replay and do not compare alternative revisions.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It directly distinguishes all three named mechanisms with the smallest reversible counterfactual.

failure_learning.observation: No counterfactual execution has run under this contract.
reuse_candidates: The frozen A4 ledger remains a development regression fixture.
